yearGuidance.1st: Spring-week applications run from about June to April: banks mostly October-November, trading and consulting January-February. yearGuidance.penultimate: Banks open summer internships from about June to September and most review on a rolling basis (Goldman Sachs says so), so apply as early in the window as you can and expect places to fill. yearGuidance.final: No internship yet? Apply to programmes that admit final-year students (GS Summer Analyst eligibility includes final year), to off-cycle internships (Lent term is key for them), to boutique and mid-market firms (they hire less formally, year-round) and to graduate schemes at retail and corporate banks.
